summary: Stability AI's developer platform grants 25 free API credits to new accounts created via Google social login (the grant does not apply to username/password or Discord signups per the getting-started guide). API usage is billed in credits at 1 credit = $0.01. NOTE: platform.stability.ai pages render only with JavaScript and returned an empty shell to the fetcher; the quoted terms come from search-index snippets of these exact URLs and should be re-verified in a browser.
claim_steps: Choose the Google social login option — creating the account this way grants 25 free credits.
Create an API key on your account page and check the credit balance under billing.
